work_item.title: Dark/Light Theme Implementation
work_item.description: 🚩 AC Addressed (Required) Implement dark/light theme support Redesign query interface with modern, clean aesthetics 💡 What do you want to accomplish? (Required) Develop a comprehensive theming system using CSS custom properties that supports both dark and light themes with proper contrast ratios meeting WCAG accessibility standards. Implement intelligent theme detection that respects user's system preference on first visit, with a toggle control for manual switching and persistent storage of user preference across sessions. Create smooth theme transition animations and ensure all UI components, including syntax highlighting and data visualizations, properly adapt to both theme variants. 📋 Testability Considerations (Required) Visual testing for all components in both dark and light themes Accessibility testing for contrast ratios in both themes (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance) Browser testing for CSS custom property support and fallbacks User preference persistence testing across browser sessions Theme transition animation performance testing Integration testing with existing component library ⚙ Implementation (Optional) ✋ Technical Dependencies CSS custom properties support in target browsers Component library theming architecture User preference storage mechanism (localStorage/backend) 🛠️ Engineering Work To Be Implemented CSS custom property-based theming system Theme toggle component with state management Dark theme color palette design with accessibility compliance Theme-aware syntax highlighting for query editor Theme transition animations and performance optimization System preference detection and user preference persistence ⚠ Risks & Mitigations Risk: Theme switching may cause visual glitches or performance issues during transitions Mitigation 1: Implement CSS transitions carefully to avoid layout shifts Mitigation 2: Add option to disable animations for users with motion sensitivity Risk: Third-party components may not support custom theming Mitigation 1: Create theme adaptation layer for external components Mitigation 2: Select theme-compatible libraries or build custom alternatives

analysis.recommended_approach: Implement a CSS custom property-based theming system integrated with the existing component library. Detect system theme preference on initial load and apply it, then allow manual toggling with a UI control that updates state and persists preference in localStorage or backend. Design accessible dark theme color palette and ensure all UI components, including syntax highlighting and data visualizations, adapt accordingly. Implement smooth CSS transitions with fallback options to disable animations for motion-sensitive users. For third-party components, create an adaptation layer or replace with compatible alternatives. Conduct comprehensive visual, accessibility, browser compatibility, persistence, and performance testing.

implementation_steps.description: Create CSS custom properties for dark and light themes in a dedicated stylesheet, ensuring color palettes meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast standards and include smooth transition animations with a media query to disable animations for motion-sensitive users.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify CSS variables define accessible color palettes for both themes and transitions are smooth and can be disabled via prefers-reduced-motion media query.

implementation_steps.description: Develop a theme detection utility that detects the user's system theme preference on first visit and falls back gracefully if CSS custom properties are unsupported.
implementation_steps.validation: Test detection logic across browsers and simulate first visit to confirm correct theme application.

implementation_steps.description: Implement a React hook to manage theme state, including persistence of user preference in localStorage and fallback to system preference on initial load.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify theme state persists across page reloads and sessions, and defaults correctly on first visit.

implementation_steps.description: Create a ThemeToggle React component that allows users to manually switch themes, updates the theme state, and persists the preference.
implementation_steps.validation: Confirm toggle control updates theme immediately, persists preference, and is accessible.

implementation_steps.description: Refactor QueryEditorSyntaxHighlighting component to adapt its styles dynamically based on the current theme using CSS custom properties.
implementation_steps.validation: Check syntax highlighting colors adapt correctly in both themes with proper contrast.

implementation_steps.description: Develop DataVisualizationThemeAdapter component or utility to ensure all data visualizations adapt their color schemes according to the active theme.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify charts and graphs update colors correctly on theme change without performance degradation.

implementation_steps.description: Integrate the theming system with the existing component library to ensure consistent theme application across all UI components, including third-party components by creating adaptation layers or replacing incompatible ones.
implementation_steps.validation: Perform visual regression testing to confirm consistent theming and no visual glitches.

implementation_steps.description: Conduct comprehensive testing including visual tests, accessibility audits for color contrast, browser compatibility checks for CSS custom properties, persistence validation, and performance testing of theme transitions.
implementation_steps.validation: All acceptance criteria met with no regressions or accessibility violations.

implementation.pr_description: Implemented a comprehensive dark/light theme system using CSS custom properties with WCAG 2.1 AA compliant color palettes. Added intelligent system theme detection, manual toggle control with persistence, smooth transitions respecting motion preferences, and full UI component adaptation including syntax highlighting and data visualizations. Ensured browser compatibility with fallbacks and integrated with existing component library. Included extensive testing for accessibility, performance, and visual correctness.
